x_938076_backup_0_backup_scripts.description: For some instances where data corruption was identified as per PRB1594463, the Business Rule "Cascade Update Logical Datacenter State" was updated as a part of a write audit, if it was out of the box. If the audit caused the BR to be updated, then this fix script marks that update with replace_on_upgrade as true, so that upgrade process upgrades this script as to what is shipped OOTB from servicenow. It will remain unaffected if the script is customised by customer.
x_938076_backup_0_backup_scripts.name: Mark Audited BR PRB1594463 Upgradable
